title: Take Care of Yourself
subtitle: 考点：关心他人 / Take care of yourself.

dialogue.t: Sam, you are not at school today. Are you OK?
I am at home. I had a cold, but I am better now.
Take care of yourself. Did you see a doctor?
Yes. The doctor says I should rest and eat healthy food.
That is a good habit. I eat fruit and vegetables every day.
I will do the same. Thank you for calling.
You are welcome. See you on Monday!

vocab: take care of 照顾 · rest 休息 · habit 习惯 · check 检查 · stay 待 · enough 足够的

questions.stem: What does the doctor say Sam should do?
questions.why: I should rest and eat healthy food.
